correctness.rationale: For q>=2 and prime p>2q, any nonidentity p-rotation preserving a nonempty finite subset has all orbits of length p, impossible below p elements; the C_p action on E_(2q-1),E_(2q) is free. Tuffley proves each cover has homotopy type S^(2q-1) and inclusion has degree 2 in top homology. The Cartan–Leray/Serre spectral sequence has rows t=0,2q-1 and only differential d_(2q); its coefficient must be a unit mod p or quotient cohomology remains infinite-dimensional, contradiction. Naturality fixes a_+=2a_-. A homotopy equivalence would induce deck generator s and degree epsilon=+/-1 on covers, forcing 2 in signed qth powers. Explicit independent modular computation checks 2 outside signed quadratic residues for p=5,13,29,37,61 (all 5 mod8); Dirichlet and quadratic reciprocity prove infinitely many. UCT yields same ordinary homology. This arithmetic sample is not a proof of the universal spectral-sequence statement.
